pois.note: Kongens Have, centre of the park (OSM leisure=park centroid); open lawn and paths, away from Østre Stationsvej
Hovedbiblioteket (main library) in Odense Banegård Center; public, step-free, indoors when it is cold
Jernbanegade pedestrian street just south of Kongens Have; car-free and step-free
Path by Landsarkivet for Fyn on the west side of Kongens Have, about 120 m from the arena centre (moved from Elisabeth Klixbülls Plads, which lies in a no-spawn cell by the railway)
Banegårdspladsen, the square in front of the station (bike parking nearby)
Pedestrian Slotsgade south of Odense Slot; moved from Gravene (17 m from the district 3 border) so the whole 50 m radius lies inside district 1
Kongensgade pedestrian street by the artwork The Guardians Light
Klosterhaven, the public garden just south of Sankt Knuds Kirke. Skt. Knuds Plads itself (north side of the cathedral) is only ~50 m from the district 1 border, too close for the 80 m arena radius
Munkemøllestræde by H.C. Andersens Barndomshjem; cobbled old-town street, public, check step-free access on site
Albaniengen, the public green by Sankt Albani Kirke
Sankt Jørgens Park, public park by Odense Å
